name: Amanoi
positioning: Aman resort in Vinh Hy Village on Vietnam's south-central coast, with a beach club, a spa and local Cham-culture experiences
best_for: Travelers who want local culture, such as Cham heritage, pottery and village dinners
Guests who want a resort base with a beach club, a spa and wellness programmes

facts.text: Cam Ranh Airport (CXR) is a 75-minute drive from Amanoi.
Amanoi is in Vinh Hy Village, Vinh Hai Commune, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam.
Amanoi has a Beach Club restaurant where a barbecue dinner of seafood and grilled dishes is served on the sand every Saturday evening.
Guests can have an intimate, family-style Vietnamese dinner at the home of Ba Hai in Thai An village, ten minutes from Amanoi.
Guests can join a local artisan for a Cham pottery workshop, a craft still practiced in the nearby village of Bau Truc.
Amanoi has a spa, Amanoi Spa.
Amanoi offers a three-day Mobility and Recovery Retreat created in collaboration with Aman Global Wellness Ambassador Novak Djokovic.
Amanoi offers private dining at Lotus Lake.

highlights.text: A Sacred Cham dining experience takes guests to a nearby hidden spot for local delicacies and ends with a blessing ceremony by a Cham master in the jungle.
Guests can take a private hands-on Vietnamese cooking class at the Rock Studio, surrounded by giant granite boulders.
The Lost Kingdom of Cham journey includes a guided tour of the Cham Museum and a visit to the 13th-century Po Klong Garai Cham Towers.

considerations.text: Cam Ranh Airport (CXR) is a 75-minute drive from Amanoi, so the transfer is part of the trip.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires longer travel time.
WhataHotel notes an ultra-luxury pricing point.
